about.title: About Us
about.text: Welcome to Polerinna – your home for Pole Dance and Aerial Arts. We offer classes for all levels, from beginners to advanced dancers. Our experienced instructors will guide you on your journey to greater strength, flexibility, and confidence.
about.values_strength_desc: Build muscle and discover your physical power
about.values_flexibility_desc: Improve your mobility and body control
about.values_community_desc: Become part of a supportive and inspiring community

agb.title: Terms & Conditions
agb.section1_text: These General Terms and Conditions apply to all contracts between Polerinna (hereinafter 'Studio') and the customer regarding participation in courses and use of the studio facilities.
agb.section2_text: Registration for courses is done exclusively online via the Eversports booking system. A booking becomes effective once the customer has received a confirmation email.
agb.section3_text: Payment is made according to the conditions specified in the booking system. All prices are final prices including the applicable VAT.
agb.section4_text: Free cancellation is possible up to 12 hours before the start of the class. For later cancellations or no-shows, the full class price will be charged. In case of illness, please cancel early and provide a medical certificate.
agb.section5_text: Participation in classes is at your own risk. Customers are obligated to inform the instructor of any health restrictions. Participation is not permitted if you have health complaints.
agb.section6_text: The studio is not liable for injuries caused by improper application of the techniques learned, nor for theft or damage to items in the studio.
agb.section7_text: Customers are obligated to observe the house rules of the studio. The studio reserves the right to expel persons who violate the house rules.
agb.section8_text: The collection and processing of personal data is carried out in accordance with our privacy policy and the legal provisions of the GDPR.
agb.section9_text: The studio reserves the right to change these terms at any time. Changes will be communicated to customers by email.
agb.section10_text: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies. Place of performance and jurisdiction is Munich.
